summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report its net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026. The filing provides NAV per share for multiple share classes (e.g., Class S $10.4102; Class I $10.4826) and a detailed breakdown of NAV components, including real estate investments, debt, and other assets/liabilities. This is a routine periodic NAV disclosure, not a special situation event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate action terms. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed. No risk-arb angle applies.
